name: claude-workflow-kit
description: nil-park's personal Claude Code workflow skills, managed via GitOps.

plugins.name: project-skills-bootstrap
plugins.description: Installs a set of shared working conventions into the project. Together they govern how a change is written, reviewed, documented, and delivered, where its working files live, and how idiomatic its Korean prose reads. Each convention is a separate bootstrap skill, so a project can adopt only the ones it needs. The skill files are written under .agents/skills/ and symlinked from .claude/skills/, so the repository carries them. Skills that work only in Claude Code, one orchestrating several peer sessions and two pairing the current reviewing session with a single file-editing peer (duo-session and the deprecated duo-session-agy, whose peer agent definitions go under .agents/agents/), are written directly under .claude/skills/ instead. The Korean-prose convention also installs a Stop hook that flags English-calqued Korean in files the turn just edited, registering it in the project's settings.json.

plugins.name: user-tools-bootstrap
plugins.description: Installs personal tools that live outside any project. The statusline skill builds the Go status line binary into ~/.claude/bin with go install and points statusLine in the user settings at it. The agy-compaction-hook skill builds the Go compaction hook binary with go install and registers it in ~/.gemini/config/hooks.json. Invoking either of those two skills again rebuilds its binary from the latest main. The claude-message skill installs an Antigravity skill of the same name at ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/claude-message/SKILL.md and builds claude-queue with go install only when it is not already on PATH.
